optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Dreams
entries: You gain the {@spell veil of dreams|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell sleep}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of the Elements
entries: Natural disasters and inclement weather hold more power than the mightiest creature. You gain the {@spell elemental betrayal|PC1} hex. Your familiar learns your choice of {@spell breathe fire|PC1}, {@spell gust of wind|PC1}, {@spell hydraulic push|PC1}, or {@spell pummeling rubble|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Life
entries: Life can be shared. You gain the {@spell life boost|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell spirit link|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Protection
entries: An ounce of protection is worth a pound of cure. You gain the {@spell blood ward|PC1} hex; your familiar learns {@spell mystic armor|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Vengeance
entries: Suffer not even the smallest slights. You gain the {@spell needle of vengeance|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell phantom pain|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Mischief
entries: Nothing's wrong with some mischief, now and then. You gain the {@spell deceiver's cloak|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell mad monkeys|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Shadow
entries: A shadow is far from empty—it contains something of the person who casts it. You gain the {@spell malicious shadow} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell chilling darkness}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Snow
entries: Emulate snow, for it can snuff out life despite its gentleness. You gain the {@spell personal blizzard|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell wall of wind|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Death
entries: Death is final, yet not as inescapable as it may seem. You gain the {@spell curse of death|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell raise dead|PC1}.

optionalfeature.name: Lesson of Renewal
entries: Entropy comes for all, but it can be wound back through effort. You gain the {@spell restorative moment|PC1} hex, and your familiar learns {@spell field of life|PC1}.
